{"metadata":{"description":"ChatGPT Codex login, sortable catalog, and Fast models for DeepSeek Harness","id":"gh:1336844228","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-llm-codex","slug":"NOirBRight/dsh-llm-codex","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"ChatGPT Codex login, sortable catalog, and Fast models for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-llm-codex"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"ChatGPT Codex integration for DeepSeek Harness. This plugin is a separate provider route (`codex`) a"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"nd settings namespace (`llm-codex`). It does not declare `apiKeyEnv`, does not read or write `~/.cod"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"ex/auth.json`, and does not share a credential file with `dsh-codex-connect`."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"The package root exposes the Cordis plugin contract. The same artifact exports `./client`, which con"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"tributes the Codex card under Settings → LLM Providers."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"DSH peer and development dependency ranges accept `0.1.7-alpha.2` and later releases. Cordis peers a"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ccept `>=4.0.4 <5.0.0`."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Verified Hosts in `package.json#dsh.compatibility.dshReleases` are evidence, not an allowlist. Unkno"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"wn newer Hosts warn once and keep the normal mount path. Only a reproduced failure is blocklisted."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"`catalogId` and the unresolved `unknown` account state are attached at runtime. Published `dsh-llm-p"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"roviders-ui` 0.2.8 omits those fields and treats `unknown` as unconnected; they only take effect on "},{"id":"p9s3","text":".2.8 omits those fields and treats `unknown` as unconnected; they only take effect on a newer Owner."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Install directly from GitHub:"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"The repository tracks release-ready lib artifacts, so GitHub installation needs no build-script allo"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"wlist. A source checkout can use a link installation after running `pnpm run build`."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Management RPC"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Settings and authentication management use the authenticated `/api/plugin-rpc/codex` fetch route. Th"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"e Host `/api` carrier applies its Host/Origin checks, cookie authentication, and body limit before d"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"ispatch; this plugin has no separate remote-management switch."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Web configuration"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Open Settings → LLM Providers → Codex. **Sign in with ChatGPT** starts the official ChatGPT OAuth fl"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ow, opens the system browser, and stores the session only on the Host at `$DSH_HOME/codex-oauth.json"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"` (mode `0600`). The card then shows usage limits. Sign out deletes that file. The browser never rec"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"`). The card then shows usage limits. Sign out deletes that file. The browser never receives tokens."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The collapsed header first-paints the last successful quota from the shared browser cache; error, un"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"supported, and signed-out states paint no cached meter. Signing in, signing out, or an authoritative"},{"id":"p18s3","text":" signed-out status purges the cache in every bundle copy, even without providerDirectory."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### Model catalog"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The conversation picker uses the displayed catalog stored as `settings.models`. The default is six r"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"conversation picker uses the displayed catalog stored as `settings.models`. The default is six rows:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"- `gpt-5.6-sol` / `gpt-5.6-sol-fast`
- `gpt-5.6-terra` / `gpt-5.6-terra-fast`
- `gpt-5.6-luna` / `gp"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"/ `gpt-5.6-sol-fast`
- `gpt-5.6-terra` / `gpt-5.6-terra-fast`
- `gpt-5.6-luna` / `gpt-5.6-luna-fast`"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Fast and 1M are first-class picker rows, not checkboxes. Chat still uses the official wire id; Fast "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"rows send `service_tier: "priority"`. 1M rows (`gpt-5.6-sol-1m`, `gpt-5.6-sol-1m-fast`, and the Terr"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"a/Luna equivalents) set `contextWindow` to 1,000,000 so DSH compaction waits until 80% of that budge"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"t (800k). They are not in the default six-row catalog; add them from the official picker. The overla"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"y can also add `gpt-5.5`, `gpt-5.4`, `gpt-5.4-mini`, `gpt-5.3-codex-spark`, and Fast variants. Custo"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"m ids can be added manually.
The official picker fetches the live account catalog using an unfiltere"},{"id":"p22s7","text":"d discovery client version; newer models (including `gpt-6-sol` and `gpt-6-luna`) appear without upd"},{"id":"p22s8","text":"ating the static defaults. Choosing rows does not add them to conversations until saved. Offline, th"},{"id":"p22s9","text":"e last successful catalog is reused; discovery alone does not guarantee chat compatibility with futu"},{"id":"p22s10","text":"cessful catalog is reused; discovery alone does not guarantee chat compatibility with future models."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Picker ids may also use a generic context suffix `-<n>k` or `-<n>m` (for example `gpt-5.6-sol-272k` "},{"id":"p23s2","text":"or `gpt-5.6-sol-272k-fast`). The plugin peels that suffix before talking to ChatGPT and uses `n×1000"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"` / `n×1,000,000` as the DSH compaction budget, so a 272K row starts compacting earlier than a 1M ro"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"w. Product names such as `kimi-k3-max` are not treated as a context tier. The composer picker groups"},{"id":"p23s5","text":" sibling rows that share a base id."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Default reasoning effort is per model and editable on the row: Luna uses `max`, Terra `xhigh`, Sol `"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"high`, and every other official Codex model `xhigh`. Fast and 1M rows use their base model's default"},{"id":"p24s3","text":". A reasoning effort explicitly selected in a conversation takes precedence."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"### Remote compaction (not enabled)"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"### Model Switch integration"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"When `dsh-model-switch` v0.2+ is present, Codex registers optional Search and Image adapters that re"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"use this plugin's authenticated clients. Model Switch keeps official `web_search` ownership and leav"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"es `view_image` / `codex_generate_image` unchanged. No Vision adapter is registered."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"### Optional capabilities"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Search, `view_image`, and `codex_generate_image` are implemented but default off. Enabling any of th"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"em and clicking Save registers or unregisters it immediately; no restart is required. Search registe"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"rs a standalone Codex `WebSearchProvider` (`POST /codex/alpha/search`). It does **not** write `web.s"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"earchProvider` or `agent-default-model`. The search-model dropdown lists official non-Fast models an"},{"id":"p31s5","text":"d defaults to `gpt-5.6-luna`. The plugin also registers `web/openai-codex-search-llm-request` so ses"},{"id":"p31s6","text":"sion logs written by `dsh-codex-connect` remain readable after that plugin is uninstalled. Search mo"},{"id":"p31s7","text":"des match official Codex:"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"- `cached` (default): OpenAI-maintained index, no live fetch
- `indexed`: live fetch only when the s"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"earch index gates the request
- `live`: unrestricted live retrieval"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"`view_image` is a model-invoked tool for local files and public-network HTTP(S) images. Spark is tex"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"mage` is a model-invoked tool for local files and public-network HTTP(S) images. Spark is text-only."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"`codex_generate_image` is a separate model-invoked tool. Any conversation model can call it; it uses"},{"id":"p34s2","text":" this plugin's ChatGPT login and Codex usage (typically 3–5× a text turn) and draws with backend `gp"},{"id":"p34s3","text":"t-image-2`. The routing-model dropdown lists official vision models and defaults to `gpt-5.6-luna`. "},{"id":"p34s4","text":"The name is intentionally not `generate_image`, so it does not collide with other provider plugins. "},{"id":"p34s5","text":"Generated files land under `generated-images/` unless `path` is set."}],"truncated":true}
